objective: Show that the knot axiom K2 makes every knot strictly terraced in McQuillan's sense, that exactly 26 of the 34 knots are windable by his criterion for three-place functions, so that native counting with pins has a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for each of them given his winding theorem, and that the 8 knots that are not windable are exactly the knots excluding three tuples, two of which (the topological no-lone-value knots) count exactly.
status: Proved by NATIVE-APPROX-20261024-001A-P001 (V1 prose proof with standard-library check; approximation scheme cited). K2 makes every knot strictly terraced; a knot is windable exactly when it excludes at most two tuples or is parity (26 of 34), so given McQuillan's winding theorem native counting has an FPRAS for each; the 8 knots excluding three tuples are not windable, and apart from the two topological ones, six knots remain without an efficient counting algorithm.
title: Windable knots count approximately
